blocks.text: You can connect your Smartsheet organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with System Admin privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Smartsheet organization.
To connect your Smartsheet organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Smartsheet.
In the Add Integration window, select the relevant product from the drop-down menu, if your tenant resides in one of the non-default regions.
Generate an API access token. To learn more, refer to the Smartsheet documentation.
Paste the token under API access token in the Add Integration window.
Click Connect to complete the integration.

blocks.text: Your Smartsheet organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
